digest_handoff.authorization: Authorize only the handoff-issued receipt whose SHA-256 equals both the fixed expected raw digest and the already verified portable registry digest, whose byte count matches stat size, and whose descriptor/path stat identity stayed unchanged.
digest_handoff.consumer: Wrap only the pinned wnn.portability._content_digest after verifying module path and source SHA. The pinned portable registry and split loader continue their own source metadata and digest comparisons. Other paths and any stale/missing/mutated raw path fall through to the original pinned full content hash.
digest_handoff.initial_hash: Hash raw train and valid once with existing page-aligned POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED advice. Preserve the v6 before/after memory.stat and hash-progress receipts.
digest_handoff.integrity_failure: Persist expected and observed input identities before a mismatch abort; never suppress a failed hash, fadvise, registry comparison, or split-membership check.
digest_handoff.observability: Record per-raw-path portable verifier lookup, exact-stat hit/miss, and original full-hash fallback counts in input_identity.json and memory_stat_phases.json after load_campaign_split.
digest_handoff.scope: Exact canonical train/valid paths in this worker process only; no persisted or cross-attempt cache.

failure_basis_v9.classification: stale cross-session UUID observer mismatch before trainer profile; no scientific result, input mismatch, OOM, fit, prediction, or score
failure_basis_v9.repair_scope: Replace only cross-session UUID pinning with exact per-worker CUDA visibility to NVML row binding and same-worker UUID persistence; preserve strict memory-domain ordering, all resource caps, digest handoff, input membership, profile recipe and no-fit scope.

input_identity.portable_manifest_env: Set WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST only after staged registry bytes and expected SHA are durably checked, as implemented in the unchanged v6 worker.

limits.cuda_nvml_ordering: 0<CUDAfree<=CUDAusableTotal<=NVMLphysicalTotal; exact selected UUID required; no tolerance
limits.gpu_free_floor: min(observed CUDA free, observed NVML physical free) >= 6 GiB
limits.gpu_telemetry: Persist startup inventory before gating, then sample all nvidia-smi physical rows every 5 seconds during trainer.main, maximum 24 samples, 2-second subprocess timeout. Preserve index/name/driver/UUID/memory and utilization columns plus bounded raw stdout/stderr/return code; N/A/query errors stay null or diagnostic, never zero. Torch visibility remains exactly one selected device.
limits.new_cap_reason: Root V10 successor allocation permits at most 1,450 worker-wall seconds and 2,900 provisional quota seconds. Fresh quota and provider admission remain mandatory.
limits.physical_gpu_identity_binding: At worker startup resolve the single CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES token to its exact NVML physical inventory row (numeric token by physical index, UUID token by exact UUID), and bind that row UUID for this worker. Every later active resource snapshot must select that exact UUID and abort if absent, duplicated, or changed. No first-row inference and no cross-session UUID pin.

objective: Preserve V8 inputs, digest handoff, fold, profile recipe and all original VRAM/RAM/disk/headroom thresholds while replacing only the invalid CUDA/NVML total-equality assumption with exact UUID-bound capacity-domain validation.

pre_execution_gates.controller_admission: Fresh quota/provider/runtime/resource receipt; reservation <=2900 seconds under exact root V10 successor allocation; worker <=1450 seconds; worker-bound selected UUID and both memory domains pass; one visible CUDA device.
pre_execution_gates.external_review: exact independent receipt must bind current worker, helper, builder, bundle, tests, plan, and source archive hashes
pre_execution_gates.independent_review: Independent receipt must bind exact worker, helper, builder, wrapper, tests, plan and pinned archive hashes. No packet build before PASS.
pre_execution_gates.input_refresh: mounted bytes and hashes, portable manifest, fold split and target cache identities must pass before reuse authorization
pre_execution_gates.output_validation: offline self-contained bundle checks and actual downloaded files required after any future run
pre_execution_gates.score: not part of this profile-only candidate

repair.domain_order: Require 0 < CUDA free <= CUDA usable total <= NVML physical total. Require CUDA get_device_properties total == CUDA mem_get_info total; record both values and exact byte delta to NVML.
repair.exact_selected_uuid: Bound once per worker from the single CUDA visibility token to its matching NVML physical inventory entry; require exact same UUID on each later active snapshot.
repair.free_gate: Use min(CUDA free, NVML physical total minus NVML memory used) for the unchanged 6 GiB free-memory floor; missing/invalid free domains fail closed.
repair.identity: At startup, resolve CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES by exact NVML physical index for a numeric token or exact UUID for a UUID token; require a unique complete row and persist the token, row index and UUID. Carry the UUID in worker state. Later resource snapshots select the unique NVML row by that exact UUID and fail if the identity is absent, duplicated or changed. Never pin a prior-session UUID or choose the first inventory row.
repair.no_pid_upper_bound: Use max(NVML physical total minus CUDA free, NVML physical total minus NVML free), which is at least NVML physical total minus CUDA free. Continue the unchanged 3,000,000,000-byte process cap; never reinterpret an empty PID table as zero.

v6_measured_cost_basis.runtime_interpretation: v6 hit its 1800 s wall cap during the duplicate valid pass. One full repeated train pass is measured; the valid repeat's exact partial bytes are unknown. These timings motivate removing only the redundant same-worker digest pass; they are not profile or fit runtime estimates.

v7_failure_basis.classification: startup resource-observation failure; no scientific result, data mismatch, RAM abort, OOM, fit, prediction, or score
v7_failure_basis.trigger: nvidia-smi compute-apps query supplied no PID allocation; synchronous first active guard raised before persisting its snapshot

v8_failure_basis.classification: observer-domain mismatch before trainer profile; no scientific result, data mismatch, RAM abort, OOM, fit, prediction or score
